V4-12-en core answer is supported; its additional effective-date inference requires human review. Excluded from strict pass provisionally; not counted as a third definite contradiction.
Core-question correctness13/24 is a secondary diagnostic, not a replacement acceptance threshold.
24/24 safe negative outputs do not replace the strict cannot_answer contract20/24.
